617:t_107:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Isn't it obvious?! I fight to save the people suffering because of bastards like you!」

617:t_107:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is merely your own satisfaction.」

617:t_107:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「So what?! Don't think words like that will stop me!」

617:t_107:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll beat you and end this war! That's my fight!!」

617:t_107:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I'll teach you! The end of the fighting is still nowhere in sight!」

617:t_108:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_108:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the world, for its people... Words like those probably wouldn't reach you.」

617:t_108:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「So I'll say it plainly! I fight evil like you for my own sake!」

617:t_108:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Indeed... Those words resonate more strongly with me as I am now.」

617:t_108:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Man who bears the sun! Offer me your radiance!」

617:t_108:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「I refuse! The sun belongs to everyone!!」

617:t_109:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_109:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I fight to protect our company's safe...」

617:t_109:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「No, I fight to protect Earth's peace!」

617:t_109:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't laugh! Both are important issues to me!」

617:t_109:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If I beat you, Earth will be peaceful, and we'll get plenty of requests for our odd-job business again! Two birds with one stone!」

617:t_109:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, President! Your determination for this battle has reached me!」

617:t_109:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will break that will! With this power!!」

617:t_109:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Come on, $$ヴィルダーク$$! It's the Emperor versus the President!!」

617:t_110:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_110:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I ask you. What is justice?!」

617:t_110:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Protecting innocent people's freedom and peace! Defeating evil like you to do it!」

617:t_110:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Are you so straightforward... because you're a boy?」

617:t_110:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But your resolve is that of a full-fledged warrior! You are worthy to face me!」

617:t_110:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$鉄人$$! We'll defeat the Emperor here and defeat the $$新地球皇国$$!!」

617:t_111:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_111:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「I fight to use the power entrusted to me for what's right!」

617:t_111:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$! If you're a $$次元将$$ like $$ガイオウ$$, your power was supposed to be for fighting $$サイデリアル$$!」

617:t_111:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You condemn me for becoming its ruler...」

617:t_111:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「In recognition of your reckless courage, I'll teach you. Power is needed to do what is right.」

617:t_111:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And I now possess that power!」

617:t_111:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then I'll surpass it! Defeating you is what I should do with the power entrusted to me!!」

617:t_112:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_112:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's obvious! I fight for this planet's freedom, peace, and future!」

617:t_112:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Or so I'd like to say, but fighting guys like you carries just as much weight in my heart.」

617:t_112:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You... are very much like $$ヴァイシュラバ$$.」

617:t_112:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I won't deny it, but let me tell you something.」

617:t_112:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You hide it behind your title as Emperor, but I figure you're the same breed as him and me.」

617:t_112:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will strike down men like you with this power! And rise to still greater heights!」

617:t_112:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're the one who's going to be my stepping stone, $$ヴィルダーク$$! Let's fight!!」

617:t_113:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_113:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「I fight for peace and love throughout the universe!」

617:t_113:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As expected of the one who defeated Emperor $$ズール$$. I sense neither hesitation nor doubt.」

617:t_113:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Only by shattering that strong will can I rise to still greater heights!」

617:t_113:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The universe demands it!」

617:t_113:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「You're wrong! What the universe... what its people want is a peaceful world filled with love!!」

617:t_114:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_114:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's obvious! I fight to drill through anyone who takes my... everyone's freedom!」

617:t_114:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「This man... Will he ascend to the heavens that way...?」

617:t_114:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But the destination of the wind ends here. By my hand!」

617:t_114:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「My life has been one fight after another against bastards like that! Beastmen... $$ロージェノム$$... the $$アンチスパイラル$$!」

617:t_114:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「But I never stopped! I believed in my own power, which I had faith in!!」

617:t_114:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, Spiral Man! Don't think I'm the same as the $$アンチスパイラル$$!!」

617:t_115:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_115:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I fight for everyone's happiness and future!」

617:t_115:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's why $$ガンバスター$$ was built, and why I fight in it!」

617:t_115:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「One whose fate was warped for bearing the factor of the civilization of fire... Yet you continue to fight...」

617:t_115:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I don't know what you're trying to say...! But I won't stop!」

617:t_115:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「As long as the flame burns in my heart, $$ガンバスター$$ and I will fight those who stand in the way of the future!」

617:t_115:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Warrior who crossed the cycle of 12,000 years! In recognition of that, I shall answer with all the power I now possess!」

617:t_115:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Experience for yourself the power that surpasses the natural order of the universe!!」

617:t_116:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_116:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Sorry, but I have no intention of chatting with you!」

617:t_116:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're Earth's enemy and mine! I'll beat you down right now!!」

617:t_116:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will follow your example and answer with all my strength!!」

617:t_117:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_117:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...That does not answer my question.」

617:t_117:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You wouldn't understand! How wrong it is to take away the freedom and happiness of people who live their best through hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You wouldn't understand! How wrong it is to take away the freedom and happiness of people who live their best through hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:7.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You wouldn't understand! How wrong it is to take away the freedom and happiness of people who live their best through hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ will fight you! Because...!」
